♐ Sagittarius rises Exalted today. This is the one day in two hundred and sixty. For the whole day your Techniques heighten as though you were 8 levels higher, and you have your Zenith Boon.

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

As the Ascendant Boon, plus once per minute @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Golden Arrow: Named Shot]: any creature you can name within a mile, through any barrier short of a planar boundary, takes Golden Arrow's damage plus an additional 8 dice.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. A Zenith is scheduled by the GM, never rolled.
